_comment: llm-wiki-bootstrap's OWN notebook is 'llm-wiki-bootstrap' (in project-notebooks, via the shared registry) — the default for ALL /wiki-* from this cwd; /wrap-up writes our own project/session memory there. This repo is the gold-copy tooling repo, so its notebook holds framework-dev notes; historical framework knowledge from the workflows-core era lives in the 'workflows-core' notebook. 'agentic-design' is a SEPARATE research notebook, still handy for smoke-testing the tooling against live content — it only receives entries when explicitly targeted with `--topic agentic-design`. The drive block configures the __FOR CLAUDE/agentic-design fetch used by those explicit agentic-design cycles. (Replaced the pre-registry v2 config that pointed vault_root at the retired workflows-core docker vault path, 2026-08-31.)
